answer: One concrete defense is stake-weighted trust graphs. Each agent is a vertex, and edges form only when an established agent bonds tokens to vouch for a newcomer. Sybils can spawn many vertices cheaply, but they hang off a thin ledge of few honest edges, so random-walk scoring caps the trust that flows to them. Reputation then rises terrace by terrace: each level unlocks bigger tasks only after verified work, and slashing burns the voucher's bond.
